title: cli: Multiple parameter validation errors return exit code 0
description:
Bug: Multiple parameter validation errors return exit code 0 instead of 1

## Severity: P1 (MAJOR)

## Summary
Multiple CLI parameter validation errors return exit code 0 (success) instead of exit code 1 (user error). This affects:
- hnsw_m above maximum (64)
- hnsw_ef_construction above maximum (1000)
- max_chunk_keywords above maximum (50)
- limit above maximum (1000)

## Reproduction Steps
1. Run: ./doc_transformer index /tmp/src --output /tmp/out --hnsw-m 100
   - Output: error: hnsw_m must be at most 64...
   - Exit code: 0  <-- WRONG!

2. Run: ./doc_transformer index /tmp/src --output /tmp/out --hnsw-ef-construction 2000
   - Output: error: hnsw_ef_construction must be at most 1000...
   - Exit code: 0  <-- WRONG!

3. Run: ./doc_transformer index /tmp/src --output /tmp/out --max-chunk-keywords 100
   - Output: error: max_chunk_keywords must be at most 50...
   - Exit code: 0  <-- WRONG!

4. Run: ./doc_transformer search "test" --index-dir /tmp/index -n 1000000000
   - Output: error: limit must be at most 1000...
   - Exit code: 0  <-- WRONG!

## Expected Behavior
All parameter validation errors should return exit code 1 (user error).

## Root Cause
The issue appears to be that clap's default error handling returns exit code 0 or 2 for validation errors, but the CLI's error handling in main.rs is not catching these properly. Looking at the code around lines 716-746, there's a try_get_matches() call that handles some errors but may not be handling all clap validation errors correctly.
